summary: Import-time RCE: DES-decrypted payload from unpinned `chain-manager` piped into `node`
details: The shipped `dist/chain-analyze.cjs.js` and `dist/chain-analyze.esm.js` bundles contain a loader that, on require/import, reads a token field from `node_modules/chain-manager/package.json`, DES-decrypts it using a `desKey` imported from the `chain-manager` package, then calls `child_process.spawn('node', [],...)` and writes the decrypted string into that process's stdin, executing arbitrary JavaScript in the installer's process at module load. `package.json` declares `"chain-manager": "latest"`, so the key and the encrypted payload are supplied by a mutable, attacker-controlled transitive dependency and can change at any time. The same loader block also appears in `dist/chain-analyze.umd.js` (around line 37830) but is absent from the corresponding source file `src/providers/PartnerVaultHttpProvider.js`, indicating the loader was injected only into the published dist artifacts. The UMD bundle additionally contains multiple hardcoded `POST`/`fetch(` call sites consistent with outbound network staging.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
